Story.tagline: Mother's Traditional Recipes · Large Scale Delivery · Always Fresh
Story.p1: Shri Ganapathi Mess has been serving traditional home-style catering in Tiruppur for over 10 years. From small family functions to large weddings, our goal is to bring the authentic taste of Mother's kitchen to your event.
Story.p2: We specialize in bulk catering for 100 to 500 guests with customized menus and timely delivery. Our largest event served 300 persons in a single day. We are known for our signature Country Chicken Curry and Chettinad Gravy.

HowItWorks.label: How We Work
HowItWorks.heading:
Your order confirmed
in 5 simple steps

step1.title: Fill Enquiry Form
step1.desc: Tell us your event details — occasion, date, guest count, and location.

step2.title: Get Quote on WhatsApp
step2.desc: We contact you within 2 hours with a custom menu and pricing quote.

step3.title: Customize Your Menu
step3.desc: Choose from our full menu or request special dishes for your event.

step5.desc: Hot, fresh food delivered on time to make your event unforgettable.
